ITEM 1 | Two rectangular wedge-shaped pieces of baked flatbread-style crust with golden-brown, slightly charred bottom edge; top covered in melted white cheese with scattered red-orange tomato sauce spots and some browned cheese patches; cut into two connected slices, each roughly 6 cm long and 4 cm wide, sitting at the lower-right edge of a white square plate covering about 12% of plate area; thickness about 1.5 cm, moderately moist and soft-looking cheese, crust firm | 110

ITEM 2 | Red-orange tomato sauce visible as scattered spots and smear on top of the cheese and crust, glossy and slightly moist, sitting on the pizza pieces; small amount, about 1 cm wide patches | 8
